name: NURS 3234
title: Theory and Nursing Practice for Adults with Sub-Acute or Chronic Problems
description: Critical examination of theory, research and expert clinical practices supportive of nursing care for the adult population. This includes adults from diverse cultures and vulnerable communities that are experiencing sub-acute and/or chronic health conditions and the impact of illness on client families and caregivers.
requirement_description: To enroll in this course, a student must have earned a "C" or better in NURS 1130, 1131, 3100, 3110, and 3120; open only to Nursing majors. May not be taken out of sequence after passing NURS 3225 or 3715W.
